(4 GB RAM). A call arrives. After the call she opens eight other apps, and
then she taps the icon of the game again.

a) Write the states of the game in order, from the call until the game is
ended. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

when she taps the icon? (1 mark)
